findings.title: Past-due cancelled reminders are deleted before they are cancelled
findings.body: The cron first deletes every EMAIL reminder whose scheduledDate is <= now, and only later looks for cancelled:true reminders within the next hour. A reminder cancelled shortly before it is due can therefore be deleted by this deleteMany without ever receiving a SendGrid cancel call. The same cleanup drops cancellations whose SendGrid request failed on a previous run. With a 15-minute cron interval, cancelling a reminder minutes before send can still result in the email being sent. Process cancellations before deleting past-due rows, and for reminders due before the next cron run cancel immediately or otherwise guarantee a run before send.

findings.title: Reschedule still uses direct SendGrid cancellation and bypasses the new cancelled flag
findings.body: When rescheduling, old email reminders are cancelled with immediateDelete=true. That performs a direct SendGrid scheduled_sends cancel instead of setting cancelled for the cron path. This is the same flow that can hit SendGrid's 100 pending-cancellation limit; when the request fails the helper only logs, no cancelled state is persisted, and the old reminder can still be sent after the booking was rescheduled. Normal reschedules should use the deferred cancelled flag, with immediate cancellation only when the send is imminent.

findings.title: Workflow reminder cancellations are not awaited on booking cancellation
findings.body: The updatedBookings.forEach invokes deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder without await or Promise.all. The handler can return, or continue to send cancellation emails, before these async DB/SendGrid/Twilio operations complete. In a serverless runtime pending work may be dropped, leaving email reminders with cancelled unset so the cron never cancels them and the reminder email is still sent. Collect and await these cancellation promises.

findings.title: requestReschedule no longer awaits workflow reminder cancellation
findings.body: The previous code awaited the Prisma reminder deletions. The new forEach fires deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder without awaiting them, and the Promise.all was removed. The requestReschedule mutation can finish before the reminders are marked cancelled; if those updates are lost, the old reminder remains uncancelled and will still be sent after the booking is cancelled/rescheduled. Await the cancellation promise set.

findings.title: immediateDelete branch leaves the WorkflowReminder row uncancelled and without retry state
findings.body: When immediateDelete is true, the helper cancels the SendGrid batch and then returns without deleting the WorkflowReminder or setting cancelled. Reschedule callers do not cascade-delete this row, so it remains as a scheduled reminder. If the SendGrid request fails, the catch only logs and no persisted state allows the cron to retry, so the reminder can still be sent. Either delete the row after a successful cancel or persist cancelled so it can be retried and cleaned up.

findings.title: Disabled event-type reminder cancellations are now fire-and-forget
findings.body: The previous code collected Prisma delete promises and awaited Promise.all. The new remindersToDelete.flat().forEach calls deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder without awaiting them. The mutation proceeds to update event-type associations and return before the cancellations finish; if the process is torn down, reminders for disabled event types are never cancelled and emails continue to be sent. Collect the returned promises and await them.
